messages:
tara: kicking off a config-only change for routing floors + idle timeouts during tonight's change window (00:30-01:30 UTC). planned canary 2%.
deploy-bot: scheduled: deploy_id=deploy-2790012345, type=config-only, target=prod, canary=2%
lee: oncall ack. will watch SLOs and flamegraphs. subscribing to alerts.
frank: posting the config diff now so we don't blind-roll: 
```yaml
routing:
  min_weight_percent: 3  # floor for stable routes
  fallback_policy: region-preferred
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  window_ms: 10
timeouts:
  stream_idle_ms: 20000
  head_ms: 1100
```
nia: quick note: bumping min_weight to 3% to prevent tiny routing thrash for small tenants. ok with canary?
tara: launching canary at 2% now
deploy-bot: canary live -> tweak-variant receives 2% traffic. monitor stream-idle and tail latency.
obs-bot: canary metrics @2% (5m): p50=44ms, p95=165ms, p99=305ms, error_rate=0.00%
ops-bot: alert rule dry-run: will fire if tenant p99 increases +150ms over baseline for >4m
...5m later...
lee: saw a small cluster of traces with increased stream idle reconnects, looks correlated to a tenant with long streaming sessions. p99 for that tenant ~520ms.
frank: interesting — stream_idle_ms lowered from 30s to 20s; that could be causing more reconnects and higher overall tail. maybe too aggressive for streaming-heavy tenants.
nia: proposed remediate: roll canary back to previous stream_idle_ms for the tweak variant only (config patch) and hold canary.
tara: agree. run targeted hotpatch to restore stream_idle_ms->30000 for canary variant and keep other params. include rollback instruction in notes.
deploy-bot: hotpatch command: `/deploy config-only --patch '{"timeouts":{"stream_idle_ms":30000}}' --to prod --variant=tweak --canary 2%'

deploy-bot: hotpatch started: patch_id=patch-2790013001, status=canarying
obs-bot: hotpatch canary metrics (3m): p50=43ms, p95=158ms, p99(affected-tenant)=210ms, error_rate=0.00%
lee: looks much better for streaming tenant. other tenants unchanged.
tara: recommendation: merge hotpatch into main config and continue ramp to 30% over 10m, then full rollout if stable. rollback plan: `/deploy rollback deploy-2790012345` or reapply config hash `cfg-8a3f`
frank: adding note to release: mention targeted canary hotpatch to revert stream_idle, reason=reduce reconnects, owner=lee, rollback-owner=nina.
nia: small correction: rollback-owner should be @frank (he owns the routing config).
frank: updated. thanks.
deploy-bot: ramping patch-2790013001 -> 30% (10m ramp)
obs-bot: 30% after 12m: p95 steady, p99 within +20ms baseline, no increase in errors.
lee: extending monitoring 2 hours per policy. alert thresholds: tenant error_rate > 0.4% OR sustained p99 delta +250ms for 5m triggers rollback.
tara: documenting release notes: - config-only change: routing.min_weight_percent 0->3, batching.max_batch_tokens 4096->2048, batching.window_ms 12->10, timeouts.stream_idle_ms 30000->20000 then reverted for canary; hotpatch merged. change window closed 01:05 UTC.
frank: pinning config version cfg-8a3f to variant v13 for 48h.
ops-bot: if rollback executed, run `ops run migrate-routing --from cfg-8a3f --to previous` and notify #oncall with deploy_id.
tara: thanks team. closing thread; will re-open if alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
